known.via: English Wikipedia "Lacrima di Morro d'Alba" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A red DOC in the province of Ancona, in Marche, made from the rare local Lacrima grape. Created in 1985, it is a small DOC of about 250 hectares in the Marche region.
